description: Tap row that opens the existing CategoryPicker. Shows selected category or a placeholder; handles the no-categories empty state inline.

hasCategories.description: Whether any category exists for the current type

onCreate.description: Route to category creation when none exist

behavior: numberOfLines=1 on the value, chevron pinned. In noCategories state the row shows a dashed border, outline icon, the word 'No … categories yet' and a '+ Create' action instead of opening an empty picker.

accessibility.label: Category, {selected name or none selected}, opens category picker
accessibility.colorIndependent: Empty state uses word + outline icon + dashed border, not color
